title: Ashby's table, four disturbances and two responses (toy, ours)
head: contract type D
check R1
check R2
best pick
notes: A new contract of type D1 arrives. Check R1 leaves the books in state a; check R2 leaves state b. Pick R1.
Type D2: the supervisor sees which type it is and picks R2, which also gives a.
Type D3: R1 gives c, R2 gives d. Pick R1.
Type D4: pick R2, which gives c. No check can give a for D3 or D4, because a appears only in D1 and D2.
Best play leaves two outcomes, a and c: 1 bit. The law says V_O ≥ V_D − V_R = 2 − 1 = 1 bit, and no choice of checks can do better.
